summary: Iteration 60 - Stripe Virtual Payment Flow Testing. Backend: 16/16 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All Stripe payment features verified - Booking Engine with guest form, payment method selection (Pay Now with Card / Pay at Hotel), successful redirect to checkout.stripe.com, Payment Gateway admin panel with 4 tabs (Overview, Card Terminals, Transactions, Settings), all payment method toggles working.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/booking/reserve correctly calculates total_price (nights × base_price × rooms) and generates booking_ref
POST /api/payments/booking-checkout creates valid Stripe checkout session and returns checkout.stripe.com URL
GET /api/payments/status/{session_id} returns payment status with booking_ref field (handles test key gracefully)
GET /api/payments/transactions/{property_id} supports filtering by status and type
GET /api/payments/dashboard/{property_id} returns comprehensive stats (processed, pending, failed, success_rate, by_type, by_method, daily_trend)
Payment Settings has all toggles: Stripe, Pay at Hotel, Room Charging, Cash, Contactless, Tipping
Booking Engine frontend correctly calls /api/payments/booking-checkout and redirects to Stripe
Price comparison widget shows 'Book direct & save 18%' with OTA price comparison
